sloka: तं भीमवेगा हरयो नाराचैः क्षतविग्रहाः ।अन्धकारे न ददृशुर्मेघैः सूर्यमिवावृतम् ।। ६.४५.६ ।।।।
transliteration: taṁ bhīmavegā harayo nārācaiḥ kṣatavigrahāḥ ।andhakāre na dadṛśurmeghaiḥ sūryamivāvṛtam ।। 6.45.6 ।।।।

translations.english: The Vanaras were mangled with iron arrows, however endowed with high speed they could not make out Indrajith in utter darkness just as the sun covered by clouds.
translations.hindi: उस निबिड अंधकार में राक्षस अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध हो कर, बडे वेग से बानरों की सेना में कूद पड़े ओर बानरों को खाने लगे
